en: A black-and-white photograph showing a street scene in front of bombed or burned-out buildings with only chimneys and some walls still standing. The foreground features a dead horse lying on a cobblestone street. Several people are visible in the background, some standing and others walking past the ruins. Trees without leaves line the street. The lower right corner includes the text 'TAMPERE HÄMEENK.'
